landing.title: Operational queue
landing.summary: Triage the work admitted for your role. Search results and row detail stay redacted until a permitted item is selected.
landing.scopeBody: Role-permitted operational work, ordered by priority, SLA, and age.

queue.title: Operational queue
queue.caption: Role-permitted work ordered by priority, SLA, and age
queue.searchLabel: Search permitted cases, events, and targets
queue.selectionHint: The queue and filters remain in place while you inspect this redacted summary.
queue.emptyBody: Change a filter or saved view. No work outside your role was searched.
queue.offline: The queue is offline. The last admitted rows remain visible and no action is queued.
queue.stale: Queue data may be stale. Refresh before confirming any review.
queue.partial: Some queue evidence is unavailable. Admitted rows remain visible; affected actions stay blocked.

support.title: Support case review
support.summary: Read the case, check consent, and prepare a response without exposing the customer identity.
support.decisionTitle: Decide whether this response is ready for review
support.decisionBody: The case is waiting for a scoped response review. You can refine the draft and inspect its evidence before confirmation.
support.subject: Startup guidance after a Windows update
support.detail: The report contains a startup state and no diagnostic payload was uploaded.
support.draftValue: I reviewed the available startup information.
support.responseHint: The subject is the only safe draft field. Response text is cleared when the review is cancelled.
support.cancelled: Response draft cancelled. No message was sent and no remote event changed.
support.purpose: Prepare a scoped response for this support case.
support.impact: Confirmation includes only the reviewed response for this case.
support.constraintsBody: Review is limited to the case and response fields permitted for the support team.
support.authorityBody: Remote sending is unavailable. The response can be reviewed safely and no message will be sent.

operations.title: Operations review
operations.summary: Triage the release alert and review safeguards before any operational decision.
operations.decisionTitle: Keep publication held while evidence is incomplete
operations.detail: The review reports a manifest mismatch. Publication remains blocked and no artifact is promoted.
operations.purpose: Keep the release held while evidence is reviewed.
operations.impact: Publication remains held for this release; no change was applied.
operations.mobile: Alert triage and evidence review remain available on mobile. Confirmation requires at least 960px.
operations.authorityBody: The release credential and promotion channel are disconnected. The hold remains unchanged.

security.title: Security review
security.summary: Inspect the risk alert and prepare a specific response without exposing credentials or sensitive data.
security.decisionTitle: Keep containment pending until the retry evidence is reviewed
security.detail: A request exceeded the expected retry window. No account, token, address, or diagnostic value is present.
security.purpose: Prepare containment review for this security alert.
security.impact: Containment would affect only the identified session. No revocation or block was applied.
security.authorityBody: Security credentials, the session channel, and revocation are disconnected. The target remains unchanged.

diagnostics.title: Consent-scoped diagnostics
diagnostics.summary: Diagnostic detail stays closed unless purpose, permitted fields, expiration, actor, and immutable audit reference all match this object.
diagnostics.blockedBody: No valid consent covers this diagnostic object. Metadata below explains the required scope without revealing diagnostic or customer data.
diagnostics.requiredPurpose: Review startup evidence for case SUP-2048
diagnostics.denial: Absent, expired, or wrong-scope consent reveals no diagnostic field and creates no authority.

audit.title: Immutable audit timeline
audit.summary: Correlate complete events in immutable records with protected targets and scoped access.
audit.caption: Immutable administrative events

admin-event-002.reason: Record a blocked diagnostic consent review

receipt.title: Review complete — no change was made
receipt.body: Review complete. No remote state changed; the receipt and correlated audit record remain immutable.

recovery.title: Administrative capability unavailable
recovery.offline: The disconnected authority is offline. Safe review remains available and no request is queued.
recovery.stale: The record is stale. Refresh it before any confirmation.
recovery.expired: The session expired. No credential or sensitive draft was retained.
recovery.permission: This role does not include the requested responsibility. No data was disclosed.
recovery.failure: The remote capability did not respond. No remote state changed.
recovery.safeDraft: Only the case subject is eligible for local recovery. Response and diagnostic fields are discarded.
